method.remainingSweep: 585 remaining physical coordinates: 14 meridian front/side full-coordinate sweeps, checking gross region errors, sequence reversals, discontinuities, and bilateral asymmetry.
method.caveat: Visual/model-level anatomical audit of BodyParts3D/WHO-derived coordinates; not cadaveric or imaging ground truth.

sweepResult.result: PASS except the explicitly listed CORRECT and ambiguous/model-limitation cases.
notes: All 14 meridians were reviewed in front and side projections.
No additional gross cross-region displacement or exact overlap was accepted outside the listed cases.
Long segment lines between anatomically distant consecutive meridian points were not treated as errors by themselves; they were judged against WHO regional sequence.
